name: Shifting Seas
review:
Shifting Seas is a 6-reel pirate slot with shifting reels, avalanches, special wilds and up to 117,649 ways.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 15,000x cap and a 96.15% RTP.

The shifting reel heights decide the ways count on every spin, and avalanches let one good grid pay several times. The pirate theme is bright and playful.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
